gaps.criterion: Device permission prompts handled through hdk-permissions
gaps.gap: NOT IMPLEMENTED, and deliberately not stubbed. LeadFlow's client is a React/Vite WEB app with no device layer: there is no camera, contacts or microphone permission to request, no native shell to request it from, and hdk-permissions is a ProjexCloud HDK for a mobile runtime that this project does not have. Writing a permissions module here would produce a wrapper with nothing on the other side and a test that asserts the wrapper calls itself - coverage that proves the criterion is met when nothing about it is. The criterion belongs to the mobile shell (Apple CNContact / Android contact selection, hdk-camera for cards, microphone for voice notes), which is out of this repo. The DATA those paths produce is fully supported: captureKind carries contact, business_card and voice_note, and a voice note with no name and only a property reference is accepted and tested. What is absent is the device-side prompt, not the capture path.
